reading.body:
McKinsey & Company is recorded here as a for-profit firm founded in 1926 and headquartered in New York City, and nothing else about it is verified.

The record holds no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. The text pulled from the company's own website returned only "Access Denied," so no description of its business or its position on AI could be drawn from that source. What remains is a founding year, a headquarters city, and a website address.

For a question about compute, buildings, or power, this entry carries no weight. It does not say whether McKinsey buys compute, operates data centers, or advises clients on either. The absence of products and MCP servers is a gap in the record, not a finding that none exist.

The one thing the data does establish is a limit on method. A firm can be large and well known and still yield almost nothing to automated collection, and the record says so plainly rather than filling the space.
